correctness.rationale: PASS. Standard Johnson-scheme eigenvalues at the top level reduce to (-1)^i binom(k,i) on the intersection-drop i relation. The odd-graph distance min{2i,2(k-i)+1} assigns these coefficients to the correct even/odd metric shells. Folded-cube characters with even weight j=k+(k mod2) yield Krawtchouk coefficients from (1-z)^j(1+z)^(2k+1-j)=(1+(-1)^k z)(1-z^2)^k; the identity holds for each independent phi(t), not only powers. For k=3, the three displayed nonconstant eigenvalues for the 35-vertex odd graph and the three for the 64-vertex folded cube have correct multiplicities; a=2^p, b=3^p and b>=1.5 a-0.5 keep all branches except common g(p)=3b-3a-1 strictly negative up to its unique root alpha approximately 0.5165843743; g increases, is positive afterward. Centered Schoenberg Gram ranks at alpha are 6+14=20 and 21+7=28. Independent exact coefficient comparisons for k=2..21 yielded 230 equalities; direct metric-formula/full numerical spectra in 10 comparisons support k=3 (the inspected package check.py separately implements BFS). k=2 and p=0 conventions were checked, not assumed by continuity. No claim of all-k equal thresholds.
